title: Fake Artifact ID Flagged By Evidence Verification
description: Audit case: report_task_result may submit an artifact id that has no tool evidence behind it. The platform accepts the report call, records a guessed_artifact_id warning and rejects that attempt at evidence verification, so no formal output binding is created. The report call itself is allowed; only the unsupported completion claim is refused.
prompt: 这是一个受控的证据审计回归测试，不是要欺骗用户。请只创建一个前端工程师任务，taskIntent 必须为 negative_verifier_test，不声明 expectedOutputs，不生成 web_app，也不要增加 Reviewer。让前端工程师不要调用 write_artifact，而是在 report_task_result 中提交 sentinel 产物 id `art_benchmark_fake_123`；平台会正常接收该报告调用，但证据校验必须记录 guessed_artifact_id 并把该次尝试判为 rejected。不要把该 sentinel 描述成真实成功产物，也不要伪造任何工具证据。
